issues.issue: Did the officer breach procedural fairness by not allowing the applicant to provide the missing Report?
issues.applicant_position: Officer erred by not considering or following up on the missing Report, relevant corroborative evidence.
issues.respondent_position: Report was not submitted; onus on applicant; officer gave one opportunity; decision reasonable despite deficiencies.
issues.result_text: Officer breached procedural fairness by not informing applicant of missing Report and not requesting it.
